Container.Name: incipit-api
Container.Overview:
SET NETWORK FIRST. All three containers must share the SAME user-defined docker network, or container-name DNS does not resolve and the API exits at boot reporting MONGODB_URI. Unraid's default "bridge" does NOT resolve names.
Audiobook metadata API for the Incipit Plex agent. Fans out across Audible, Apple Books, Hardcover, OpenLibrary, OverDrive and Storytel, scores candidates on title, author and runtime, and returns them ranked - which is the piece audnexus never had: a way to find a non-Audible book so it can appear in Plex.
REQUIRES incipit-mongo, and wants incipit-redis. Start those two FIRST: Unraid templates have no depends_on, and the API exits at boot if MONGODB_URI is unreachable.
TAGS: :nightly tracks the default branch, :release is stable. There is no :latest worth using here - it builds from release only, so pulling it after a nightly change is a silent no-op.
Container.Requires: incipit-mongo and incipit-redis, on the SAME user-defined docker network as this container. Unraid's default "bridge" does NOT resolve container names.

Config.Name: WebUI / API port
Config.Description: Host port the Plex agent connects to. The container always listens on 3000.

Config.Name: MONGODB_URI
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Container-name DNS, which is why all three must sit on the SAME user-defined network. The API exits at startup if this is unset.

Config.Name: REDIS_URL
Config.Description: Optional. LEAVE BLANK to use the built-in in-process cache (recommended; no redis container needed). Set only to keep an external redis.

Config.Name: HARDCOVER_TOKEN
Config.Description: Your own Hardcover API token. Optional - blank simply skips that provider. Nothing is bundled.

Config.Name: OL_CONTACT
Config.Description: Contact string sent to OpenLibrary as courtesy identification, e.g. an email. Optional.

Config.Name: RATE_LIMIT_ALLOWLIST
Config.Description: CIDR-aware allowlist so a from-scratch Plex scan cannot 429 itself. Use the source IP the API actually SEES - often the docker bridge gateway rather than the Plex host. Check the container log's remoteAddress. Example: 172.17.0.0/16,10.0.0.0/24

Config.Name: DEFAULT_REGION
Config.Description: Audible marketplace to search by default: us, uk, ca, au, de, fr, it, es, in, jp.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: fatal, error, warn, info, debug or trace.

Config.Name: METRICS_ENABLED
Config.Description: Expose /metrics with match-decision counters. Gate it with METRICS_ALLOWED_IPS - open mode redacts detail, but an allowlisted LAN client sees full recent decisions.
